known_findings.summary: graph_view(inout_as_tensor=False) indexes model.output_shape[i] for each model.outputs entry. A normal single-output model has output_shape=(None, units), so i=0 selects None and self_multiply(None) raises TypeError.
graph_view chooses Ellipses whenever node index equals ellipsize_after-2, regardless of whether units exceed the threshold. With ellipsize_after=10, 9- and 10-unit layers falsely contain an ellipsis.

SpacingDummyLayer receives None from _lazy_import_tensorflow when no backend Layer can be imported, then attempts class DynamicSpacingDummyLayer(None), yielding TypeError after a warning instead of a clear dependency exception.

layered_view defaults legend_text_spacing_offset=15 and warns whenever the value is nonzero, so every default call logs a deprecation warning even when the caller never supplied the deprecated parameter.

The focused test bootstrap says TensorFlow or Keras is sufficient, but test_dummy_model and parametrization still schedule TensorFlow paths when TensorFlow is absent. Keras-only native matrix: 27 passed, 20 setup errors.

The accumulated archive lacks root scikitplot package helpers required by visualkeras and aggdraw is not installed. Keras-only behavior was isolated in a throwaway package-root/drawing harness; real aggdraw and TensorFlow lanes remain unavailable.
